messages:
Alex: Brought lotus-v1 (fp16 -> q8) up on staging for a quick smoke. Noticed some odd spacing and punctuation placement when translating mixed CJK + RTL input :thinking_face:
Maya: Can you paste an example?
Alex: Sure — input and outputs below. baseline fp16 vs q8 quantized on staging canary:
```
INPUT: 
"今日はمرحبا world"
-- expects: "今日は مرحبا world" (space after CJK to separate RTL word)
FP16 OUTPUT: "今日は مرحبا world"
Q8 OUTPUT: "今日はمرحبا world"  <-- missing space, punctuation clinging to CJK
```
Jun: grim. tokenizer or detok? Could be tokenizer merge index change after quant kernels. Did you run the token ids diff?
Alex: Ran token-diff quickly, looks like subtoken boundaries are same for this sample, but detokenizer postprocess differs. Also saw small BLEU drop on zh->ar testset: -1.2 BLEU on staging q8 vs fp16 for mixed-orient subset.
Maya: Is the detok step language-aware? Our detok pipeline uses locale heuristics. If locale detection flips from "zh" to "unknown" it might apply CJK glue rules wrong.
Kai: I reproduced locally with the same container and canary model hash `lotus-v1@c3f2b1a`. When I run the detok binary I see different spacing because the `locale_profile` failed to load after quantized init: error `locale_profile: config empty` in logs.
Sasha: Where are those logs? link?
Alex: Dashboard -> staging/canary/lotus-v1 -> logs, but quick grep:
```
2026-03-22T14:12:03Z lotus-init: loaded tokenizer v2
2026-03-22T14:12:03Z quant-kernel: q8 init done
2026-03-22T14:12:03Z locale_profile: config empty  <-- suspicious
2026-03-22T14:12:03Z detok: fallback to simple-join
```
Jun: Huh. fallback to simple-join would remove the CJK-to-rtl spacing logic. Why would locale_profile be empty only under q8? Kernel init shouldn't affect config files. Maybe race during async bundle load.
Maya: Could be ordering: quant runtime swaps mmap layout and the profile file path resolves relative to cwd. Any chance the working dir differs in the q8 process?
Kai: Confirmed: q8 container launched with `--chdir=/opt/serving` and the profile path was `../profiles/locale.json` — which resolves differently. Our fp16 build sets absolute path at startup, q8 relies on relative.
Alex: That would explain it. Is this a rollout-blocker? It affects mixed-orient translation quality but only when the locale_profile fails. We have fallback but it's producing glue issues.
Sasha: Suggested fix: make locale profile resolution absolute in init, add end-to-end smoke that checks locale heuristics on staging canary. I'll open a quick PR.
Jun: Also add an eval to the bringup checklist: run a small multilingual detok suite and assert no spacing regressions for CJK+RTL combos. Add metric: BLEU delta and "punct spacing" heuristic (count of CJK adjacent to RTL without separator).
Maya: Putting action items: @Kai to patch starter to absolute path; @Sasha to PR detok smoke; @Alex to run expanded eval on the 10k mixed-orient set and post results.
Kai: I'll send a CI job that reproduces the issue with q8 image and runs `python infra/tests/detok_check.py --samples=1000`.
ci-bot: Job queued: detok_check/lotus-q8-2026-03-22 #1421. Link: https://ci.internal/runs/1421 :white_check_mark:
Alex: Thanks. For tracking, adding the sample diffs and a couple of failing examples to the ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ML-3481
Maya: If the fix is straightforward we can continue canary but pause wide rollout until smoke passes.
Sasha: I'll target a patch PR in the next hour and request an expedited review.
Alex: Great. Will update the thread with the eval numbers when detok_check finishes. :thumbsup:
